sections.Profile:
"King Pin" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in December 1951. The game features two reverse flippers, seven pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Bowling, Sports, Original Theme
